beats: Find the eastern-pier captain after the vault conversation.
Accept the invitation and then continue exploring the existing region if desired.
data.consequences: The present invitation permits continued exploration; voyage and island gameplay remain to be built.

description:
A working ship and an ordinary supply voyage offer a route beyond the familiar coast. The Little Promise’s invitation points the journey toward Psyduck Island.

The captain knows a route and a destination, not an authoritative explanation of the island’s creatures or magic.

sections: §30: working harbour, optional sailors and the planned island crossing.

name: The captain’s invitation
